method: Manual comparison against public Modrinth project APIs and version APIs for similar-name Verity results surfaced in current SERP sampling. These records explain routing confusion; they are not endorsements, safety verdicts, or mirrors.

projects.name: Verity Dweller
projects.sourceNote: A separate Fabric mob project that adds a fast spawning Verity-style enemy. It is not the same route as Verity JE Project ID on1Y0osD, CurseForge Project ID 1591438, Bedrock Verity BE, or PnTMC.

projects.name: Horrorland - With Verity!
projects.sourceNote: A separate Modrinth modpack route that includes Verity wording in the title. Use it only when the player intentionally wants that modpack profile, not as a replacement for the standalone Verity Mod Java or Bedrock files.

projects.name: Verity
projects.sourceNote: A Paper server management plugin with the same word in the title. It is not the Minecraft horror Verity Mod download, not Verity JE, and not a Bedrock add-on.

routePolicy: Use /verity-dweller/ when a search result says Verity Dweller, Horrorland with Verity, or a generic Modrinth Verity plugin and the player needs to know whether it is the same as Verity Mod. Use /download/ for the current standalone Verity JE, Verity BE, PnTMC, and Pocket Edition routes.
